All Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner (Zones),

All Regional P.F. Commissioners/OICs of Regional Offices
Subject : Conducting of Compliance Audit of All Exempted Establishments till

Financial Year 2016-17 — Regarding.

Reference : EPFO, Head Office Circular No. C-Ex/Misc/Comp. Audit/2015/9604
Dated : 13.08.2015

Sir,

Please refer to the subject and reference cited above. Vide circular under reference
above, it has already been made clear that compliance audit of exempted/relaxed establishments
is an annual exercise and completion of same comes under original jurisdiction of the Regional
P.F. Commissioners /Officer In-charges of field offices. The data collected from various field
offices, which has been presented before the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Labour,
reveals that upto date compliance audit i.e. upto 2016-17 has not been completed by the field
Offices.

2. In this context, it is directed that all the field offices should undertake special compliance
audit drive for ensuring completion of compliance audit of all the exempted/relaxed
establishments till Financial Year 2015-16, before 31.08.2017. During the compliance audit
following guidelines should be adhered to -

i) Special focus should be on those establishments which are engaging 20 workers or less
and their Trusts are having total corpus of less than Rs. 1 Crore.

ii) Those establishments and their Trusts should be identified which are not having the
securities in the DEMAT form and such identified establishments and their Trusts should
be reported immediately to the Head Office.

3 Subsequent to the conduct of the compliance audit strict action should be taken for
withdrawal of relaxation or cancellation of exemption, against the defaulting establishments as
the case may be. ,

[This issues with the approval of CPFC].
Yours faithfully
(K. L. Goyal)

Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner-| (Exemption)
